page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Placentation — definition
lines: The arrangement of ovules on the placenta
within the ovary is called placentation.
steps.why: The definition places the ovules in space: how they are arranged inside the ovary, on the tissue called the placenta.
common_mistakes: Defining it as the arrangement of seeds. Ovules, not seeds - seeds come after fertilisation.
steps.memory_tip: Placenta holds the ovules; placentation is how it holds them.
steps.margin_note: One sentence with ovules, placenta and ovary in it.

steps.label: Type in Dianthus
lines: the ovules are borne on a central axis and
steps.why: Free central = a free-standing central column of ovules with NO septa; Dianthus and Primula are the fixed examples.
common_mistakes: Writing axile for Dianthus. Axile has septa; free central has none - that is the difference.
steps.memory_tip: Dianthus - a free-standing pillar of ovules, no walls around it.
steps.margin_note: Name the type and add the no-septa line to show it is understood.
